description: A biology PhD student needs to digitize handwritten lab notebook data from a plant growth experiment. Open the text file at /home/ga/Desktop/raw_notebook_excerpt.txt which contains 3 days of plant measurements with inconsistent formats. Create a clean spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/lab_notebook_digitization/growth_data_cleaned.xlsx with: (1) Standardized dates in YYYY-MM-DD format, (2) All measurements converted to centimeters (some are in mm), (3) Standardized treatment codes (WW for well-watered, DS for drought stress), (4) Formula-calculated means using AVERAGE(), (5) Missing data clearly flagged. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
